title: Ye hai alam
body:
ay logon aao tumko bataun
rehmat e baari tumko dikhaun
saare jahan ka hai ek sahara
ye jo alam mere ghar pe laga hai
ye hai alam abbas ka
ye hai alam abbas ka
<<DIVIDER>>
gham se nikaale mushkilein taale
kaisa waseela rab ne diya
ye hai alam abbas ka
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ne alam jab ghar may sajaya
ghar may rakhe zehra ne qadam
door huwe sab ranj o masayib
phir kaisi mushkil kaisa gham
daste karam hai sheh ka bharam hai
jiska koi saani na mila
ye hai alam...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jo bandhi hai mashk e sakina
isko kaho taweez e wafa
rishta bhatiji aur chacha ka
aaj talak na toot saka
ek kahani iski zabani
sunlo agar sunte ho sada
ye hai alam...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho alam ka surkh pharera
chadar e zainab se hai bana
jo bhi alam ke saaye may aaya
dunya ke sab gham bhool gaya
ab jaake maana saara zamana
saaya figan ghar ghar pe hua
ye hai alam...
<<DIVIDER>>
aisa alam dunya may dikhao
jiski ataa ho rab ki ataa
shaan e azadari ye alam hai
dekho azakhano may zara
mannatein poori karta hai sab ki
zinda hai iske dam se wafa
ye hai alam...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamza o jafar ka ye alam hai
hai ye alam hyder ka alam
denge gawahi shaah e zaman bhi
hai ye mere lashkar ka alam
baarwa hyder kaabe ki chath par
lehra ke isko dega sada
ye hai alam...
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl hua jab darya pe ghazi
toot gayi maula ki kamar
laasha nahi sheh laaye jari ka
laaye alam hi khoon may tar
beti se bole shabbir ro ke
aaye nahi darya se chacha
ye hai alam...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala ke dasht ka manzar
kaise likhun rota hai qalam
baad e jari aulaad e payambar
nauha kuna thi zer e alam
baali sakina karti thi nauha
saaye may iske aaye qaza
ye hai alam...
<<DIVIDER>>
panja alam ka mesum o mazhar
daste karam abbas ka hai
paal raha hai saare jahan ko
ye bhi hasham abbas ka hai
jisne jo maanga usne wo paaya
phir to zamane ko kehna pada
ye hai alam...
author: Mazhar Abidi
